events.note: Authored for credential-evidence epic #238 (Group E follow-up) from the contract claims and handoffs E1, E2 and E3 cited in the expectation, before any scanner was consulted; carrier existence is provider-documented, the context policy is project policy. Not an independent review.

Decided 2026-10-06 by the sole maintainer (Milo Kang, milocosmopolitan, repository owner) for credential-evidence epic #238 (Group E follow-up), on the owner's instruction of 2026-10-06 (complete redact-secret#1228, #1229 and #1230 before the next release; Cases and baselines authored maintainer-only, as in Batch 2). No dissent was raised by the maintainer; the strongest counter-argument is recorded in the dissent field. Question: A documented placeholder, a masked display, a reference or an empty hapikey parameter is not a credential value? Options: flag any non-empty hapikey value; or treat the documented placeholder and a mask as non-values and leave the rest to the positive case. Decision: do not flag a placeholder, a masked display, an environment reference, an empty value or a prose mention. Reason: HubSpot presents the placeholder and the masked example as examples, and a reference or an empty parameter holds no value to protect; the broader admission of other non-values is project policy. Finalized by the sole maintainer alone under the solo-maintainer period (ADR 0020): not reviewed, not independent validation, queued for retro-review (#154). Recorded by an AI agent on the owner's instruction.
events.dissent: A mask or a placeholder-looking text can hide a real value in its visible characters or be a real value that was chosen to look like a placeholder, so not flagging it can miss a leak.
events.reversingEvidence: A HubSpot statement that a displayed mask or placeholder form carries a real value, or a second maintainer's retro-review that disputes it.
